pergunta: What is, geometrically, each of the 16 city-quadrant cells (4 cities x Q1-Q4, g10b2)? For each cell: lon/lat bbox, extent in km (equirectangular, cos phi at the center), number of nodes, number of antennas, mesh step. Do cells of the same city overlap in space (bbox intersection in km2 and nodes with the same position in two cells)? The current text says that Bauru Q1 holds the city's 794 antennas -- confirm or refute?
hipotese: The 16 cells are disjoint (bboxes of quadrants of the same city do not overlap; intersection = 0 nodes) and each has an extent compatible with 3600x30m (3600x3600 grid, step ~28-31m); the antennas are NOT clipped per quadrant -- the 794 Bauru antennas appear identically in the 4 quadrants (Q1-Q4), not only in Q1.
limiar_de_aceitacao: bbox intersection between quadrants of the same city = 0 km2 (or, if >0, count of grid nodes with identical lon/lat position between the two cells = 0) for the 4 cities x 6 pairs per city

extensao_x_km and extensao_y_km (recomputed by equirectangular projection, cos phi at the centre) match the field geometria.extensao_*_km of the run JSON (relative error <=1e-3) and are compatible with 3600 x ~30m (step within 20-35m on both axes, in the 16 cells)
n_antena per cell read from subgrafos.<papel>.n_antenna (run JSON) and identical across train/val/test within the same cell; for Bauru, compare n_antena(Q1) with n_antena(Q2,Q3,Q4)
o_que_refuta: bbox intersection > 0 km2 WITH coincident grid nodes between quadrants of the same city (geometric leakage between cells, severity blocks A1-A4, study redesign before any other test); OR extent outside 3600x30m; OR the statement 'Bauru Q1 has the city's 794 antennas' being LITERALLY false in the sense that the other quadrants do NOT have those antennas (if Q2/Q3/Q4 have n_antena different from 794 or null) -- and in that case the text must be corrected to describe correctly how the antennas enter the 4 graphs
metodo_declarado: direct reading of the geometria field (bbox, extensao, n_nos_no_grafo_de_trabalho) and subgrafos.<papel>.n_antenna of the 16 g10b2 run JSONs (c0c1cf_<cidade>_s42_Q<k>_g10b2.json); independent recalculation of extensao_km via the equirectangular formula (dlon*111000*cos(radians(lat_centro)); dlat*111000) to check against the declared field; bbox intersection per pair of quadrants of the same city computed analytically (intersection rectangle in degrees -> km2 via the same formula); if bbox intersection > 0, generate the synthetic grids (build_synthetic_grid, imported from varredura_split_geometria.py) of the two cells and count nodes with identical lon/lat; map figure with the 16 bboxes, 10km blocks and the actual partition (split_espacial_3vias_exato, seed 42) of Bauru Q1
